question: Does a predeclared optional inner-search continuation improve the complete two-task procedure under the same10800s common cap, without extra API usage or weakening completion/support/integrity gates?

wall_time_includes: initial model search and inner HPO

arms.shared_prefix: One complete fixed four-stage baseline procedure for both tasks, with actual closed call ledger and qualified full-fit exports for both. Both logical arms refer to exactly these source/split/artifact/response bytes. Prefix cost is charged to the same common clock.
arms.control: Stop after the shared complete prefix. Preserve the two validated incumbent exports; do not pad time or invent API requests.
arms.treatment: Continue inside the same remaining deadline using only predeclared Optuna parameter spaces and past fitting-scope feedback. No additional LLM requests, features, prompts or model families. Extra computation is the declared treatment.
arms.interpretation: This is a shared-prefix replay/continuation comparison. Physical prefix work/API is performed once and linked in both arms, not reported as two independent live runs.

api_matching.actual_matching: Exact shared prefix response/attempt/usage ledgers give identical logical call counts, proposal bytes and token counts for both branches. Actual prefix may use fewer than2 planner calls; no fill-up calls. Unknown retry usage remains unknown.
api_matching.wire_attempts: Existing gateway may make up to3 HTTP attempts per logical request. Record actual attempts and failed calls, not merely the logical cap.
api_matching.live_replication_limit: Future independent live runs can match configured call/output-token caps, not exact token usage or proposals. Such evidence must be reported separately, with actual tokens/latency/failures; no forced posthoc equality.

optional_phase.start_condition: Both tasks have terminal qualified baseline artifacts and fresh owned-process cleanup proof; immutable exports copied atomically before any optional worker.
optional_phase.schedule: Fixed regression-then-classification round robin. One next chronological sampler proposal per eligible task. If the current task cannot admit work, record the reason and try the next task once; stop when neither is admissible. No outer-score-based task reordering.
optional_phase.candidate_limit_meaning: Prospective safety ceiling, not a claim that32 can fit or improve quality.
optional_phase.candidate_source: Resume the existing fitting-only Optuna ask/tell sequence for that exact task/space/anchor/sampler/seed; existing failed/duplicate trials remain in order. No restart from a fresh identical seed pretending it is continuation.
optional_phase.promotion_policy: Use the unchanged predeclared research primary/confirmation mean and stable ties, followed by full refit/export/integrity checks. Until every required step succeeds, retain original qualified incumbent. Failures yield null metrics and retained failed ledger entries.
stop_reasons: not enough measured budget plus protected reserve
no new bounded proposal or safety ceiling
ordinary worker failure (candidate discard; continue only if admitted)

allowed_inputs: past completed callback durations from the same exact fitting scope/capacity envelope
past timeout/failure elapsed and censoring limits
forbidden_inputs: sorting task allocation by reused research outer scores
zero duration substituted for failure/missing data
measured_admission.included_costs: Observed whole callback cost: interpreter/startup, preprocessing, CatBoost teacher/selection, student fit, prediction/artifact writing and cleanup. Teacher time is not free.
measured_admission.history_rule: For matching valid finite positive successful durations, estimate=min(600,max(1.5*median(successes),maximum recent whole-attempt elapsed or timeout censoring limit)). Any unknown/nonfinite/nonpositive timing uses600 or refuses admission. A failed/timeout attempt cannot reduce the estimate.
measured_admission.history_window: Last8 matching chronological attempts; success median uses matching valid successes within this window. Unknown identity or capacity escalation starts cold.
measured_admission.admission_rule: Read remaining after planning/serialization. Admit only if remaining >= protected_reserve + cleanup_guard + estimated_next_seconds. Immediately recheck before Popen. Hard-watchdog the whole optional callback at min(600, remaining-protected_reserve-cleanup_guard); report allocated cap explicitly.
measured_admission.safety_limit: An estimate is not a runtime bound. The independent watchdog and fresh owned-process cleanup preserve the reserve. Unknown cleanup stops the campaign; a killed attempt remains failed/null.
measured_admission.no_transfer: Do not transfer old legacy6s regression or2e77s class-control medians into broad+teacher workers merely because the task name matches.

protected_completion_reserve.cap_semantics: Parent allocations include interpreter/startup/cleanup; actual child fit watchdog subtracts a declared cleanup margin. No900+unbounded-cleanup accounting. Caps are limits, not a promise that a candidate will finish.
protected_completion_reserve.fallback: If any confirmation/refit/export exceeds its protected cap or fails support/integrity, discard optional candidate and retain complete baseline export. Never spend the final cleanup reserve on a new trial.
protected_completion_reserve.calibration_gate: Review actual finished tm1 phase timings before freezing these proposed caps. Increase reserve or declare no admissible continuation if observed mandatory work cannot be safely bounded; never shorten the fixed prefix to manufacture slack.

legacy_illustration_only.warning: This is arithmetic on finished legacy evidence, not a tm1 available-budget forecast or measured extra work.

comparison_and_qualification.complete_procedure_unit: Both tasks under one original10800 deadline, including every mandatory phase. A failed task/cut stays in the denominator and is not a numeric zero score.
comparison_and_qualification.quality: Report paired task-specific independently recomputed outer outcomes and relative changes, support/rarest-class diagnostics, completion rate, total elapsed and tokens. Do not average raw RMSE and MacroF1.
comparison_and_qualification.research_selection_vs_evaluation: Primary/confirmation used to select within the procedure are research metrics. Independent whole-procedure outer labels are sealed from proposal/admission; reuse of historical public cuts is diagnostic and cannot certify new generalization.
comparison_and_qualification.outer_manifest_pending: Before any evaluation launch, separately predeclare paired repetitions, pristine cuts, task order/clock allocation, metrics/normalization and failure handling. Do not alter or repurpose the frozen20-study HPO jobs or reuse their selected outcomes.
discard: common deadline reset or reserve/ownership/integrity violation
extra API usage/token mismatch in the claimed shared-prefix comparison
worse independent full-procedure/support result despite inner gain
complexity/cost without independently measured quality or reliability benefit
comparison_and_qualification.operation_vs_quality: More admitted/completed trials, higher utilization or lower waste are operational observations, not quality gains or a reason to submit.

implementation_obstacles: Current optimize_recipe creates an in-memory local Optuna study and returns only selected recipe/report. A second call restarts seed/anchor and is not exact continuation. Need explicit ask/tell/sampler-state retention or verified reconstruction before implementation.
Need immutable incumbent exports and exact fitted artifact/split identity; one pending candidate avoids simultaneous two-task refit debt.
Need external shared monotonic clock and phase caps across optional workers/evaluation/refit; per-task RunBudget contexts alone are insufficient.
Need no-fit prefix parity, chronology, failure/null, boundary and reserved-cleanup tests before any model execution.
pending_before_execution: finished tm1 both-task closure/phase-cost and independent cut audit
root review of separate protocol and default-off implementation
no-fit core tests and full source/unpacked/live gates for any changed runtime
frozen source/input/plan hashes plus owned resource/cleanup coordinator review
